hero.title: Empower Your Business,
hero.subtitle: The complete Point of Sale solution designed for small businesses. Track sales, manage stock, and grow your business without relying on an internet connection.

features.title: Everything you need to run your shop
features.subtitle: Built with a focus on reliability and speed, OPOS gives you the tools to manage your business efficiently.

offline.title: Completely Offline
offline.desc: Never worry about internet outages again. OPOS works 100% offline, ensuring your business keeps running smoothly no matter what.

rich.title: Rich Features
rich.desc: From sales tracking to inventory management, get powerful tools designed specifically for the needs of small businesses.

backup.title: Manual Backup & Restore
backup.desc: Your data belongs to you. Easily create backups of your entire database and restore them whenever you need to.

sync.title: Google Drive Sync
sync.desc: Want cloud peace of mind? Sync your backups securely to your Google Drive for an extra layer of data protection.

easy.title: Easy to Use
easy.desc: Clean, intuitive interface built with Flutter. Designed for speed so you can focus on your customers, not the technology.

secure.title: Encrypted & Secure
secure.desc: Your data is protected with SQLCipher AES-256 encryption — the industry standard for securing local databases. Your business data stays private, always.

cta_bottom.title: Ready to streamline your business?
cta_bottom.desc: OPOS is available for Android and iOS. Currently distributed privately as we prepare for App Store and Play Store release. Contact me to get your copy today.
cta_bottom.note: No credit card required. No hidden fees.

showcase.title: See It In Action
showcase.subtitle: Explore the features that make OPOS the perfect companion for your business.

dashboard_ui.title: An Intuitive & Comfortable Interface
dashboard_ui.desc: A modern, intuitive UI designed to be easy and pleasant to use every single day — no training required.

monitoring_shift.title: Shift Monitoring
monitoring_shift.desc: A multi-user, multi-role app optimized for tracking and analyzing cashier shift performance in real time.

master_management.title: Effortless Data Management
master_management.desc: Master data menus make it simple to organize and maintain all your core sales data in one place.

laporan_penjualan.title: Detailed Transaction Reports
laporan_penjualan.desc: Informative and modern sales reports to keep you on top of your business performance at a glance.

analisis_stok.title: Integrated Stock Analysis & Control
analisis_stok.desc: Monitor product stock levels and analyze product performance without limits — all in one platform.
